propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OpenTelemetry span with zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, and outcome from {returned, raised}, without duplication from instrument_all.
Candidate spans must nest as children of the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, with parent-span-id assertions verifiable.
The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup and fallback resolution classification must remain unchanged by candidate instrumentation.
Candidate span reasons for raised outcomes must be redacted through sanitize_diagnostic under the message key, containing no prompt, response, credential, or unsanitized exception body.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must leave the fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off behavior.
Base installation without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error and produce identical results with tracing disabled.
